artboards.title: A block is what you place

annotations.text: The archetype is papercut's, not the project's — a fixed set to start, extensible later. What the artist meets is the block and the material.

CORRECTED: an earlier draft of this board drew 3x3 neighbourhoods and drifted into blob thinking. Authoring stays on the corner model — 16 arrangements a pairing, 15 drawn. Inside and outside corners are already among them.
Authoring and Format were drawn before the block, archetype and shape/material split. They are kept for the GID scheme and the block geometry, and will be redrawn once the model settles.
OPEN: is a block a brush that paints once, or a type the voxel remembers and re-derives? That is the largest remaining fork.
